name: Forge
summary: Developed Forge from conception through three releases, scaling the design system across athenahealth’s three core product offerings. Built the component library and supporting materials to help product teams put the system into practice. Led JavaScript framework selection for all new product development.

name: Odyssey
summary: Built React components for Odyssey, translating the design system into reusable interfaces for product teams. Integrated accessibility and testing into component development, treating both as part of the implementation from the start.

name: WPDS
summary: Partnered with designers to build and evolve WPDS components around the needs of product teams. Took an active role in adoption, working directly with teams to support implementation, answer questions, and resolve issues. Created documentation, demos, and interactive examples to support that work, and used team feedback to guide component API improvements and bug fixes.

name: Compass
summary: Migrated an existing application from its previous UI framework to components aligned with Compass designs. Reworked the front-end architecture to improve portability, addressing both how the components looked and how they fit into the application.

name: Ascent
summary: Extracting Ascent’s component library into a standalone package so it can serve other applications and AI design tools. Building and maintaining an internal tool that tracks component, prop, and design token usage, giving teams a view of how the system is used across the application.
